parameters.Features: Undervoltage Protection;Overvoltage protection;Under-voltage lockout;Overcurrent Protection;Short-Circuit  Protection;Thermal Protection;Reverse current protection;Automatic protocol detection

notes: Advertises 'EPR 28V/36V/48V' but its VBUS_IN/VBUS pins are 22 V recommended, 28 V absolute (datasheet p.5, p.6) - worse than the HUSB238A. Footnote 4 on that table is a TVS recommendation, not a high-voltage sensing arrangement.
POWER_PATH_EN (pin 20) confirms it is a port controller driving an external power path.
Requires an external EEPROM of at least 36 kb holding a configuration image generated by TI tooling (datasheet p.30, p.33). A large complexity step over the HUSB238A's 'write some I2C registers'.
designVerdict: REJECTED - VBUS pin rating and EEPROM burden
